title: statusline r9 UX: segment silent on malformed state artifact
description: Round 9. Lens: ux (validator: DR). Owner: SO session. Defect: malformed state yields a multi-line stderr diagnostic but the statusline surface renders stdout — blank gauge, silent exactly where never-silent rules; the renderer has no structured answer to consume and no clause states what the segment emits; the malformed-state fixture is never run against the segment. Citations verified: contract:163, :188, :200, :217. Proposed: resolved-candidate (state-unreadable joins the never-silent enumeration; the shell composes a worded broken-state mark pointing to vsdd status when no structured answer exists; criterion runs the segment against the malformed-state fixture).

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Fixed: state-unreadable joins the never-silent enumeration; the shell composes a worded broken-state mark on the segment (stdout, pointing to vsdd status) when no structured answer exists; criterion runs the segment against the malformed-state fixture — the glance surface never blank.
